story_title: Microsoft and NVIDIA Bring Persistent Local AI Agents to Windows PCs
caption:
Microsoft and NVIDIA just announced a massive architecture shift for Windows PCs: persistent local AI agents.

Instead of sending prompts to cloud servers, Windows is building native OS primitives called Microsoft Execution Containers (MXC) to govern AI agents executing safely in the background.

To power these background agents, NVIDIA introduced RTX Spark — offering up to 128GB of unified memory on laptops like the Surface Laptop Ultra to run 125B parameter models unmetered and offline.

Is local AI on desktop hardware the future you want, or do you prefer cloud AI?

alt_text_overall: Carousel detailing Microsoft and NVIDIA's launch of persistent local AI agents and MXC OS containers on Windows PCs.
alt_text_per_slide: Slide 1: WINDOWS JUST GAINED PERSISTENT AI AGENTS.. Microsoft and NVIDIA just unveiled OS-level infrastructure and 128GB unified memory hardware built to run persistent AI agents locally on your PC. — shown as a bold statement over a torn-edge color block.

Slide 2: NO CLOUD. NO SUBSCRIPTIONS. ALWAYS RUNNING.. Instead of sending prompts to cloud servers, Windows is building primitives directly into the operating system so AI agents run securely in the background. — shown as a headline over radiating signal rings.

Slide 3: MICROSOFT EXECUTION CONTAINERS (MXC). Microsoft announced general availability of MXC — OS-level primitives allowing agents to run persistently under operating system control, security, and governance. — shown as a headline over radiating signal rings.

Slide 4: 128GB UNIFIED MEMORY ON A LAPTOP.. NVIDIA introduced RTX Spark chips: pairing a 20-core Grace CPU with Blackwell RTX GPUs at 600 GB/s bandwidth to run 125-billion parameter models locally without sending data to the cloud. — shown as a headline over radiating signal rings.

Slide 5: 20 PETAFLOPS ON YOUR DESK.. For heavy workflows, the DGX Station for Windows delivers 748GB coherent memory on Grace Blackwell chips — running trillion-parameter models directly on Windows. — shown as a headline over radiating signal rings.

Slide 6: FROM CHATBOXES TO AUTONOMOUS WORKERS.. This shifts AI from reactive chat interfaces in browser tabs to persistent background processes that execute complex system tasks unmetered and offline. — shown as a headline over radiating signal rings.

Slide 7: THE PC IS NOW AN AGENT HOST.. Windows isn't just a place to open software anymore. Operating systems are morphing into sovereign runtime environments for local artificial intelligence. — shown as a bold statement over a torn-edge color block.
